import subprocess, sys

def install(pkg): subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--quiet', pkg])
# 1. Import libraries
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import f_oneway, ttest_ind
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
from statsmodels.stats.multicomp import pairwise_tukeyhsd

# 2. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 3. Compute BMI and filter clinical
clin = clin.dropna(subset=['height_cm', 'weight_kg']).copy()
clin['BMI'] = clin['weight_kg'] / (clin['height_cm']/100)**2
clin = clin.set_index('bcr_patient_barcode')
# BMI categories
bins = [0,25,30,np.inf]; labels=['Normal','Overweight','Obese']
clin['BMI_cat'] = pd.cut(clin['BMI'], bins=bins, labels=labels)
print("BMI category counts:\n", clin['BMI_cat'].value_counts(), "\n")

# 4. Aggregate expr to patient-level
# Map Ensembl IDs to HUGO symbols
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    install('mygene'); import mygene
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
# remove version suffix
expr.index = expr.index.str.split('.').str[0]
ensembls = expr.index.tolist()
# batch query in chunks
sym_map = {}
for i in range(0, len(ensembls), 1000):
    chunk = ensembls[i:i+1000]
    out = mg.querymany(chunk, scopes='ensembl.gene', fields='symbol', species='human', as_dataframe=True)
    out = out[~out['symbol'].isnull()]
    sym_map.update(out['symbol'].to_dict())
# Filter and reindex
expr = expr.loc[[e for e in expr.index if sym_map.get(e)], :]
expr.index = [sym_map[e] for e in expr.index]
# collapse duplicates
expr = expr.groupby(expr.index).mean()
# patient-level mean
expr_pat = expr.T.groupby(lambda s: s[:12]).mean().T
# subset to BMI patients
common = clin.index.intersection(expr_pat.columns)
clin = clin.loc[common]
expr_pat = expr_pat[common]

# 5. Load MSigDB gene sets
import gseapy as gp
libs = gp.get_library_name(organism='Human')
kegg = [l for l in libs if 'KEGG' in l]
react = [l for l in libs if 'REACTOME' in l]
name = kegg[0] if kegg else react[0]
gene_sets = gp.get_library(name=name, organism='Human')
# select pathway keys
targets = ['ADIPOGENESIS', 'FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM', 'REACTOME_ADIPOGENESIS']
pathways = [k for k in gene_sets if any(t in k.upper().replace(' ', '_') for t in targets)]
print("Selected pathways:", pathways, "\n")

# 6. Compute module scores
scores = pd.DataFrame(index=expr_pat.columns)
valid_pws = []
for pw in pathways:
    genes = list(set(gene_sets[pw]) & set(expr_pat.index))
    if len(genes) < 3:
        continue
    m = expr_pat.loc[genes].mean()
    if m.var() == 0:
        continue
    scores[pw] = m
    valid_pws.append(pw)
print("Valid pathways (>=3 genes & var>0):", valid_pws, "\n")
# merge with clinical
scores = scores.join(clin['BMI_cat'])

# 7. ANOVA + Tukey
for pw in valid_pws:
    data = scores.dropna(subset=[pw,'BMI_cat'])
    groups = [data[data['BMI_cat']==lab][pw] for lab in labels]
    if all(len(g)>2 for g in groups):
        stat, p = f_oneway(*groups)
        print(f"ANOVA {pw}: F={stat:.2f}, p={p:.3e}")
        post = pairwise_tukeyhsd(endog=data[pw], groups=data['BMI_cat'], alpha=0.05)
        print(post.summary())
    else:
        print(f"Skipping {pw}: insufficient data")
    print()

# 8. DE: Obese vs Normal across valid pathway genes
genes_all = set().union(*(gene_sets[pw] for pw in valid_pws)) & set(expr_pat.index)
obs = clin[clin['BMI_cat']=='Obese'].index
nrm = clin[clin['BMI_cat']=='Normal'].index
res = []
for g in genes_all:
    x = expr_pat.loc[g, obs]; y = expr_pat.loc[g, nrm]
    if len(x)>3 and len(y)>3:
        t,p = ttest_ind(x, y, nan_policy='omit', equal_var=False)
        res.append((g, x.mean()-y.mean(), p))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(res, columns=['Gene','log2FC','pval'])
if not res_df.empty:
    res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pval'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
    res_df = res_df.sort_values('FDR')
    print("Top 10 DE genes:")
    print(res_df.head(10), "\n")
else:
    print("No DE genes: empty gene set\n")

# 9. Plots
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
for pw in valid_pws:
    plt.figure(figsize=(5,4))
    sns.boxplot(x='BMI_cat', y=pw, data=scores, order=labels)
    sns.stripplot(x='BMI_cat', y=pw, data=scores, order=labels, color='k', size=3, alpha=0.5)
    plt.title(pw); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
# Heatmap
if not res_df.empty:
    top20 = res_df.head(20)['Gene']
    hm = expr_pat.loc[top20, clin.index]
    hm_z = (hm.sub(hm.mean(axis=1),axis=0).div(hm.std(axis=1),axis=0))
    col_colors = clin['BMI_cat'].map({'Normal':'blue','Overweight':'orange','Obese':'green'})
    sns.clustermap(hm_z, cmap='vlag', col_colors=col_colors)
    plt.show()

import numpy as np
import gseapy as gp
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import f_oneway, ttest_ind
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
from statsmodels.stats.multicomp import pairwise_tukeyhsd

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Compute BMI and filter

clin['BMI'] = clin['weight_kg'] / (clin['height_cm'] / 100) ** 2
clin = clin.set_index('bcr_patient_barcode')

# 3. Aggregate expression to patient level (mean of replicates)
expr_pat = expr.groupby(lambda s: s[:12], axis=1).mean()
# Subset to patients with BMI
common = clin.index.intersection(expr_pat.columns)
clin = clin.loc[common]
expr_pat = expr_pat[common]

# 4. BMI categories
bins = [0, 25, 30, np.inf]
labels = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
clin['BMI_cat'] = pd.cut(clin['BMI'], bins=bins, labels=labels)
print("BMI category counts:")
print(clin['BMI_cat'].value_counts(), "\n")

# 5. Retrieve gene sets
libs = gp.get_library_name(organism='Human')
# prefer KEGG, else Reactome
kegg = [l for l in libs if 'KEGG' in l]
react = [l for l in libs if 'REACTOME' in l]
gene_sets = gp.get_library(name=(kegg[0] if kegg else react[0]), organism='Human')
# select adipogenesis/metabolic sets
pathways = [k for k in gene_sets.keys() if any(tok in k.upper() for tok in ['ADIPOGENESIS', 'FATTY', 'LIPID', 'METABOL'])]
print(f"Selected pathways: {pathways}\n")

# 6. Compute module scores
scores = pd.DataFrame(index=expr_pat.columns)
for pw in pathways:
    genes = set(gene_sets[pw]) & set(expr_pat.index)
    scores[pw] = expr_pat.loc[list(genes)].mean()
# merge with clinical
scores = scores.join(clin[['BMI_cat']])

# 7. Compare across BMI groups
for pw in pathways:
    data = scores.dropna(subset=[pw, 'BMI_cat'])
    grp = [data.loc[data['BMI_cat']==cat, pw] for cat in labels]
    stat, p_anova = f_oneway(*grp)
    print(f"ANOVA {pw}: F={stat:.3f}, p={p_anova:.3e}")
    # post-hoc Tukey
    post = pairwise_tukeyhsd(endog=data[pw], groups=data['BMI_cat'], alpha=0.05)
    print(post.summary(), "\n")

# 8. Differential expression (Obese vs Normal) for each pathway
de_results = {}
for pw in pathways:
    genes = sorted(set(gene_sets[pw]) & set(expr_pat.index))
    obs = clin[clin['BMI_cat']=='Obese'].index
nrm = clin[clin['BMI_cat']=='Normal'].index
# perform for all genes in all pathways combined (unique)
all_genes = sorted(set().union(*(set(gene_sets[pw]) for pw in pathways)) & set(expr_pat.index))
res = []
for g in all_genes:
    x = expr_pat.loc[g, obs]
    y = expr_pat.loc[g, nrm]
    if len(x)>1 and len(y)>1:
        t, p = ttest_ind(x, y, nan_policy='omit', equal_var=False)
        fc = x.mean() - y.mean()
        res.append((g, fc, p))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(res, columns=['Gene','log2FC','pval'])
# adjust
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pval'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
res_df = res_df.sort_values('FDR')
print("Top DE genes (Obese vs Normal):")
print(res_df.head(10), "\n")

# 9. Visualizations
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
# Boxplots of module scores
for pw in pathways:
    plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
    ax = sns.boxplot(x='BMI_cat', y=pw, data=scores, order=labels)
    sns.swarmplot(x='BMI_cat', y=pw, data=scores, color='k', size=3, alpha=0.6, order=labels)
    plt.title(f"Module score: {pw}")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

# Heatmap of top 20 DE genes
top20 = res_df.head(20)['Gene']
hm_data = expr_pat.loc[top20, clin.index]
# z-score normalize rows for visualization
hm_z = (hm_data.sub(hm_data.mean(axis=1), axis=0)
            .div(hm_data.std(axis=1), axis=0))
col_colors = clin['BMI_cat'].map({'Normal':'#1f77b4','Overweight':'#ff7f0e','Obese':'#2ca02c'})
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.clustermap(hm_z, row_cluster=True, col_cluster=True,
               col_colors=col_colors, cmap='vlag', xticklabels=False)
plt.suptitle('Top 20 DE metabolic genes (z-score)')
plt.show()"}

expr.index = [sym_map[e] for e in expr.index]
# collapse duplicates
expr = expr.groupby(expr.index).mean()
# patient-level mean
expr_pat = expr.T.groupby(lambda s: s[:12]).mean().T
# subset to BMI patients
common = clin.index.intersection(expr_pat.columns)
clin = clin.loc[common]
expr_pat = expr_pat[common]

# 5. Load MSigDB gene sets
import gseapy as gp
libs = gp.get_library_name(organism='Human')
kegg = [l for l in libs if 'KEGG' in l]
react = [l for l in libs if 'REACTOME' in l]
name = kegg[0] if kegg else react[0]
gene_sets = gp.get_library(name=name, organism='Human')
# select pathway keys
targets = ['ADIPOGENESIS', 'FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM', 'REACTOME_ADIPOGENESIS']
pathways = [k for k in gene_sets if any(t in k.upper().replace(' ', '_') for t in targets)]
print("Selected pathways:", pathways, "\n")

# 6. Compute module scores
scores = pd.DataFrame(index=expr_pat.columns)
valid_pws = []
for pw in pathways:
    genes = list(set(gene_sets[pw]) & set(expr_pat.index))
    if len(genes) < 3:
        continue
    m = expr_pat.loc[genes].mean()
    if m.var() == 0:
        continue
    scores[pw] = m
    valid_pws.append(pw)
print("Valid pathways (>=3 genes & var>0):", valid_pws, "\n")
# merge with clinical
scores = scores.join(clin['BMI_cat'])

for pw in valid_pws:
    data = scores.dropna(subset=[pw,'BMI_cat'])
    groups = [data[data['BMI_cat']==lab][pw] for lab in labels]
    if all(len(g)>2 for g in groups):
        stat, p = f_oneway(*groups)
        print(f"ANOVA {pw}: F={stat:.2f}, p={p:.3e}")
        post = pairwise_tukeyhsd(endog=data[pw], groups=data['BMI_cat'], alpha=0.05)
        print(post.summary())
    else:
        print(f"Skipping {pw}: insufficient data")
    print()

# 8. DE: Obese vs Normal across valid pathway genes
genes_all = set().union(*(gene_sets[pw] for pw in valid_pws)) & set(expr_pat.index)
obs = clin[clin['BMI_cat']=='Obese'].index
nrm = clin[clin['BMI_cat']=='Normal'].index

for g in genes_all:
    x = expr_pat.loc[g, obs]; y = expr_pat.loc[g, nrm]
    if len(x)>3 and len(y)>3:
        t,p = ttest_ind(x, y, nan_policy='omit', equal_var=False)
        res.append((g, x.mean()-y.mean(), p))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(res, columns=['Gene','log2FC','pval'])
if not res_df.empty:
    res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pval'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
    res_df = res_df.sort_values('FDR')
    print("Top 10 DE genes:")
    print(res_df.head(10), "\n")
else:
    print("No DE genes: empty gene set\n")

# 9. Plots
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
for pw in valid_pws:
    plt.figure(figsize=(5,4))
    sns.boxplot(x='BMI_cat', y=pw, data=scores, order=labels)
    sns.stripplot(x='BMI_cat', y=pw, data=scores, order=labels, color='k', size=3, alpha=0.5)
    plt.title(pw); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
# Heatmap
if not res_df.empty:
    top20 = res_df.head(20)['Gene']
    hm = expr_pat.loc[top20, clin.index]
    hm_z = (hm.sub(hm.mean(axis=1),axis=0).div(hm.std(axis=1),axis=0))
    col_colors = clin['BMI_cat'].map({'Normal':'blue','Overweight':'orange','Obese':'green'})
    sns.clustermap(hm_z, cmap='vlag', col_colors=col_colors)
    plt.show()"}
